newsitem.title: USA: New York Bancorp ups div, sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: New York Bancorp ups div, sets stock split.

text.p: New York Bancorp Inc, said Friday that it is raising its quarterly dividend and declaring a three-for-two stock split.
The quarterly dividend will be $0.225 per share, up from $0.20. It is payable January 23 to shareholders of record January 9, the company said.
After the split, the quarterly dividend will be $0.15 per share, the company said. The split distribution will be made to shareholders of record January 9.
New York Bancorp, the holding company for Home Federal Savings Bank, said it had 11,044,794 shares outstanding before the split.
New York Bancorp shares gained 1/2 early Friday to 34-5/8.
